content.short: Unicly is an NFT fractionalization protocol that allows users to tokenize and trade NFT collections with liquidity.
content.description:
Unicly is a pioneering decentralized protocol designed to solve the problem of liquidity in the NFT market by enabling the combination and fractionalization of digital assets. The platform allows users to lock various NFTs—including high-value collectibles like CryptoPunks—into a vault and mint corresponding "uTokens" (ERC-20). These uTokens represent fractional ownership of the entire collection, allowing them to be traded on automated market makers with high liquidity.

Powered by the UNIC token, the protocol features a robust governance model where uToken holders can vote on the "reserve price" required to unlock and auction the underlying NFTs. Unicly provides a professional-grade framework for NFT asset management, enabling both retail and institutional participants to build diversified portfolios of digital collectibles. Through its commitment to technological innovation and community-driven development, Unicly is building the essential infrastructure for a more efficient and accessible global NFT economy, where high-value assets are treated as liquid digital securities.
